answer: Put social graph closeness proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 454 aliases would need 454 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the ivory of the check, count the juniper of the cost, and read the tide of the history before any answer is graded. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
